components: A durable expression and time zone define recurrence.
One epoch-fenced scheduler owns materialization for the schedule.
The owner creates a uniquely keyed occurrence for the time slot.
The occurrence is delivered with normal retry semantics.
After downtime, missed occurrences are skipped, coalesced, or replayed explicitly.
